title: Glowing snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='globe' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2a5f8f'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#16365a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d2240'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eaf6ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#eaf6ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='base' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a06a3c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5e3a1c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo behind globe -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- base -->
  <path d='M26 72 Q26 66 34 66 L66 66 Q74 66 74 72 L74 80 Q74 86 66 86 L34 86 Q26 86 26 80 Z' fill='url(#base)'/>
  <rect x='26' y='64' width='48' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8b57a'/>

  <!-- globe glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='28' fill='url(#globe)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#7fc4ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- little scene inside: snowman -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='7' fill='#f4faff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='5' fill='#f4faff'/>
  <circle cx='48.2' cy='38' r='0.9' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='38' r='0.9' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <path d='M50 40.5 L52.8 41.5 L50 42.3 Z' fill='#ff9d3c'/>
  <rect x='45' y='34' width='10' height='2.2' rx='1' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='31.2' width='3' height='3.2' fill='#3a7bd5'/>

  <!-- snowflakes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='1.4' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='53' r='1.3' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='23' r='1.1' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='1.3' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='59' r='1.4' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='14' r='1' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='15' r='1' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='57' r='1.1' fill='#d8efff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='64' r='1.2' fill='#d8efff'/>

  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M35 25 Q42 19 52 19' fill='none' stroke='#bfe3ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
